description: Separate probe (a) and swap-test (b) procedures. Readers and alignment fit on training identities only; scoring identities are held out. Positive, no-op and shuffled controls calibrate the procedure, while donor-follow and selectivity concern the evaluated carrier. This schematic has no empirical seed average or accuracy; full controls and support are in Appendix C.
